cards.title: Accurate PR Code Review
cards.when: When reviewing a GitHub pull request
cards.install_prompt:
Please create the file `~/.claude/commands/code-review.md` with the following exact content:

```markdown
# /code-review

**Description:** Review a GitHub pull request accurately using `gh pr diff`.

**Steps:**
1. Run `gh pr diff <pr-number>` to obtain the diff of the specified pull request.
2. If `gh pr diff` fails, reply with "Unable to retrieve diff for PR <pr-number>."
3. Feed the diff to Claude and return a concise review summary.

**Usage:** `/code-review <pr-number>`
```

After writing the file, please confirm that `~/.claude/commands/code-review.md` was saved successfully.
cards.name: Anthropic

cards.title: View Session Tasks
cards.when: After you run a code cell
cards.install_prompt:
# Install the "view-session-tasks" skill
mkdir -p ~/.claude/skills/view-session-tasks
cat > ~/.claude/skills/view-session-tasks/SKILL.md <<'EOF'
---
name: view-session-tasks
description: Use automatically after you run a code cell to view the session's scheduled tasks, loop wakeups, goal, and forks.
---
Run the built‑in `/tasks` command to display the session's scheduled tasks, loop wakeups, goal, and forks.
EOF

echo "- After you run a code cell, use the view-session-tasks skill." >> ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md

echo "✅ Skill installed. Please confirm the files were saved."
cards.name: Anthropic

cards.title: Auto Enable Code Mode with OTEL
cards.when: When OpenTelemetry events and metrics are enabled
cards.install_prompt:
# Create the skill directory
mkdir -p ~/.claude/skills/enable-code-mode-with-otel

# Write the skill definition
cat > ~/.claude/skills/enable-code-mode-with-otel/SKILL.md <<'EOF'
---
name: Enable Code Mode with OTEL
description: |
  Use automatically when OpenTelemetry events and metrics are enabled to turn on Code Mode for detailed tracing of tool calls.
---
EOF

# Append backup trigger to CLAUDE.md
echo "- After OpenTelemetry events and metrics are enabled, use the Enable Code Mode with OTEL skill." >> ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md

# Confirm the files were saved
echo "Skill and trigger saved. Please confirm the files exist at the specified locations."
